name: jev-seo
description: Full live SEO audit of any website from its homepage URL, powered by Jev (TypeSafe's System One model). Crawls the site live (robots.txt, sitemaps, internal links, JavaScript rendering when needed), runs 52 deterministic checks tied to Google Search Central, measures Core Web Vitals with PageSpeed Insights, asks Jev batched typed questions about every page (page type, intent, importance, helpfulness, specificity, trust, citability, title and meta fit, competing pages), scores and ranks every fix, then exports a designed PDF with charts and Jev-style infographics, an Excel action tracker and a Markdown report. Use when the user says "jev seo", "audit this site", "SEO audit", "site audit with Jev", or gives a homepage URL and wants an SEO report, PDF, XLSX or MD.

findings.excerpt: r = requests.post(BASE + path, auth=self.auth, json=[task], timeout=120)
